example.note: Family max operating power; not measured SPI4MHz current and not a guaranteed startup pulse bound.

decision: Do not qualify generic microSD by capacity/price alone. This example maximum exceeds existing battery discharge budget; slower SPI is not proof of bounded card-internal current.
qualification: Pin a purchasable exact card SKU and stable hardware revision where possible
Obtain or measure startup/write/idle currents and busy duration across voltage, fullness and temperature
Check battery pulse specification, protection behavior, LDO current/transient and capacitor droop
Verify continuous16h recording without queue overrun; record supply waveform and average current
Do not assume average-current target covers peak demand; no capacitor substitution without pulse-duration bound
